meta.name: EVA firetruck from the south — migrated from firetruck_from_south.xosc
meta.description: V2XCarla EVA pull-over choreography, re-expressed natively on SimForge. A firetruck approaches the RFS intersection from the south on road 26 lane +1 at 30 km/h and drives through it toward a goal on the north-west leg. The ego sits on the same lane between spawn and intersection (externally controlled in the drive session; stationary here) so the truck must approach it from behind. Original semantics preserved: BasicAgent route-following with obstacle yield becomes the engine's collision-avoiding customRoute follower; AcquirePositionAction becomes a t=0.5s route interaction; the 120 s storyboard safety timeout becomes clipSeconds; the collision evaluation criterion becomes the engine's contact guard. Weather ClearNoon maps to clear/noon.
meta.author: v2x-scenario-migration

roles.label: drive-session ego; externally controlled (xosc external_control). Held standing at the xosc TeleportAction pose by an explicit stop command; live control arrives via V2 BridgePort.
EVA firetruck, BasicAgent-equivalent route follower at cruise 8.33 m/s

interactions.label: external-control stand-in: the ego holds its teleport pose until the drive session commands it (in production the EVA toast asks the driver to yield)
BasicAgent obstacle standoff: hold ~8 m behind the ego while approaching along the lane route — emergency-stopping clear of it if it stands still, never ploughing through

semanticMap.AcquirePositionAction: firetruck laneRef + initialRoute lanePath through the junction — the engine's lane-chain follower reproduces the GlobalRoutePlanner route; the default collision-avoidance follower (IDM) reproduces BasicAgent's stop-behind-obstacle behavior; goal arrival verified in the clear-road evidence run
semanticMap.external_control ego: non-static scene_absolute role held by an explicit stop command — keeps the ego visible to the follower's leader detection exactly like the ScenarioRunner-attached ego was
semanticMap.ControllerAction overrides: dropped: no SR controller fight to suppress on the deterministic engine
semanticMap.ReachPositionCondition tolerance 6 m: arrival check in the verification harness
semanticMap.basic_agent_control: engine lane-route follower with default IDM collision avoidance and driverProfile 'cautious' — slows and stops behind a standing ego instead of ploughing through
